purpose: Complete table-and-column coverage with evidence-scoped game semantics.

sources.editor_evidence: SoloLevelingSaveEditor.exe Python bytecode and its decrypted GameData catalogs.

comparison_limits: The saves use different generated row IDs, so row identity is not inferred from primary-key equality.
Row-count differences are evidence of different save state, not proof that every delta was caused by unlocking content.
schema_only entries preserve full coverage without assigning unsupported game semantics.

entities.entity: Character, hunter, shadow, and main-character roster
entities.notes: The roster discriminator is c_d79538c3b8: 0=main character, 1=hunter, 2=shadow, 3=main-character preset.
The editor reads this table to protect equipped emotes from removal.

entities.entity: Owned costumes, hair, and face accessories

entities.notes: c_9e0be258cc resolves to ItRelic.ID. c_1535b8b416 is used by the roster weapon-equipment table.

columns.name: c_bb428f8ca1
columns.meaning: Awakening node or skill group ID

entities.notes: The editor uses this same table for both awakening-node and hunter-skill operations. Individual rows must be correlated with the roster before modification.
The editor inserts costume unlock rows here. The compared rows also contain CharCostume and ItemProfile IDs, so this is broader than costumes alone.
The editor documents this _ID-style weapon table as a dead ledger. c_9e0be258cc resolves to ItRelic.ID.
The editor documents this _ID-style weapon table as a dead ledger. c_f24809310e resolves to ItemGS.ID.

entities.entity: Main-character class presets, core stats, skills, and scroll storage
entities.notes: Preset 0 is the active preset. The five core-stat fields store displayed stat minus one; c_c982c144a0 is unspent stat points.

entities.entity: Artifact equipment loadouts by roster and preset
entities.notes: Each pair is an artifact instance ID followed by an ItArti catalog ID: chestplate, helmet, gloves, boots, necklace, ring, earring, bracelet.
The editor's GrantAllBlessingStones operation uses this table. It has the same item/count shape as material inventory but is a distinct store.
The editor's GEAR engine names this ARTIFACT_TABLE. c_4ec2cde1a1 resolves to ItArti.ID.

entities.entity: Player profile, selected title, and counters
entities.notes: The editor uses this as ACCOUNT_TABLE/PROFILE_TABLE and reads its selected-title and profile counter fields.
c_f24809310e resolves to ItemGS.ID. Its schema matches the legacy hunter-weapon ledger but it is not labelled by the editor's GEAR constants.
The editor documents this _ID-style artifact table as a dead ledger. c_4ec2cde1a1 resolves to ItArti.ID.
c_d4f6740b9b identifies the roster record. Every nonzero c_1535b8b416 value resolves to tb_16b100425f.c_1535b8b416 in the all-unlocked save.
